title: person-member-key-store — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the B2B member-vault-key derivation (derive_person_vault_member_key: Argon2id over the normalized phrase under the salt domain 'myne.v0.2 argon2id-person-vault-member|' with the vault account_number_hash in the salt slot) and the device-local member-key-store AAD (aad_person_member_key_store: role 'person-member-key-store', vault_id || account_number_hash, v0.2 prefix). Both are cross-implementation contracts (myne-md/myne#711 task 25, decisions/protocol/0602).
